entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Al-Arba'een Mosque is a former Sunni mosque, that was located in the city of Tikrit, in the Saladin Governorate of Iraq. It contained a shrine for Amr ibn Jundab Al-Ghafari, and another shrine for Sitt Nafisa. The mosque was destroyed by ISIL on 24 September 2014.
